extracted.intended_audience: Researchers applying to Wellcome for grants, current grantholders, and research organisations administering Wellcome funding
extracted.subtask_description: High-level guidance and scheme-level priorities from Wellcome outlining what they fund, the strategic programmes, how to prepare and manage applications, and the policies/grant conditions applicants and organisations must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of funding / strategic mission
rubrics_metrics.description: We fund research to improve life, health and wellbeing through new knowledge and understanding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should align with Wellcome’s mission of improving life, health and wellbeing by generating new knowledge and understanding; alignment with this purpose is a fundamental expectation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alignment with Wellcome strategic programmes
rubrics_metrics.description: Our strategic programmes — Discovery Research; Climate and Health; Infectious Disease; Mental Health.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should target one or more of Wellcome’s strategic programmes. For example, read what Wellcome does and doesn’t fund in discovery research and consult programme-specific pages (Climate and Health, Infectious Disease, Mental Health) to check fit and priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of disciplines eligible
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding covers a broad scope of research, including physical and social sciences, clinical research and humanities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wellcome funds across disciplinary boundaries; applicants from physical sciences, social sciences, clinical research and the humanities can be eligible provided their work relates to life, health and wellbeing as per Wellcome’s mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority toward urgent health challenges and enabling discoveries
rubrics_metrics.description: We’re spending £16 billion in the decade to 2032 on a range of activities to enable discoveries and advance solutions for urgent health challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wellcome places emphasis on work that enables discoveries or advances solutions for urgent health challenges; applicants should consider whether their proposal addresses such challenges and contributes to enabling discoveries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of the Wellcome Funding Platform for applications and grant management
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for or manage a grant through the Wellcome Funding Platform. Log in to Wellcome Funding Platform / Log in to Wellcome Funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All applications and grant management actions (apply, manage, claim funds, report progress) are handled via the Wellcome Funding Platform; applicants and grantholders must use this platform for submissions and administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare to apply — application writing, eligibility, and support
rubrics_metrics.description: Get information on how to write a grant application, disability-related support for applicants, eligibility and grant conditions you and your organisation will need to agree to.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before applying, applicants should consult guidance on how to write the application, check eligibility criteria, review grant conditions, and seek offered disability-related adjustments/support; meeting eligibility and agreeing to grant conditions is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant management obligations — finance, progress reporting and notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Find out how to claim grant funds, report grant progress and notify Wellcome of any changes in circumstance, such as taking parental leave.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grantholders must follow Wellcome’s administrative and financial procedures: claim funds according to instructions, submit progress reports, and promptly notify Wellcome of changes in circumstances (e.g. parental leave) that affect the grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding policies and grant conditions — expectations of grantholders and organisations
rubrics_metrics.description: Find out what we expect of you and your organisation when you hold a Wellcome grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Successful applicants and their host organisations are bound by Wellcome’s funding policies and grant conditions; applicants should review these policies to understand rights, responsibilities and compliance requirements while holding a grant.
